scope: Native strict boolean erlang:not/1; no truthiness conversion or admission of other boolean BIFs.
adaptations: Charge one bounded native step, reverse only the exact true/false atoms and preserve BADARG for all other valid owned terms. The BIF neither allocates nor collects.
Add only the exact not/1 ID to the positive plain-BIF whitelist and use existing complete native BIF groups, including infrastructure-failure precedence over guard branching.

Compile normal body calls and a standard-assembly Y-source/Y-destination guard BIF. The latter tests actual BIF guard execution rather than a compiler optimization to an atom comparison. Independent OTP reference covers both boolean results and nonboolean guest errors/guard failure.

Test each work prefix for valid and invalid operands in body and guard paths. Allocation-denial tests begin at the actual BIF after caller frame setup and retain the mandatory VM return reserve. Shared-worker tests cover exact bytes, exact/one-below budgets, reuse, peer survival and reclamation.
